## Professional Summary
Seasoned Senior Mobile Application Engineer and Systems Architect with 7+ years of experience in system design and architecture, specializing in scalable mobile systems, on-device AI inference (LiteRT, ONNX, CoreML), biometric hardware integrations, Point of Sale (POS) terminal fleets (10,000+ devices), and high-concurrency fintech platforms serving 50M+ users.

## Core Architectural Pillars
1. On-Device AI Inference: INT8 quantized LiteRT & ONNX runtime integration for sub-20ms edge classification and OCR.
2. High-Concurrency POS Systems: Multi-channel interoperable QR (EMVCo), hardware abstraction layers for 45+ POS models, and thermal printing via ESC/POS byte streaming.
3. Offline-First Resilience: Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) with SQLite/Room DB, binary audit trails, and zero-loss background syncing.
4. Security & Compliance: PCI-DSS v4.0.1 compliance, AES-256 encrypted local vaults, biometric authentication, and hardware-backed keystore attestation.

## Flagship Production Systems
- DGePay & Bebsayi (FinTech & POS): Powering 10K+ point-of-sale terminals with sub-60ms QR recognition, real-time merchant settlement, and universal peripheral drivers.
- Sarkari Kroy Dorpon (CPTU e-GP): Central procurement client for the Government of Bangladesh supporting 100K+ contractors and encrypted tender submissions.
- UNICEF Adolescent Health: Nationwide healthcare application with robust offline-first synchronization across remote Bangladesh regions.
- praniSheba (IoT & AgriTech): Cattle biometric, RFID, and computer-vision weight estimation platform for rural farmers.
